decisions.reason: The process data archiving software has survived the earlier consolidation with Product B and fits the firm's shift to web-based, data-driven infrastructure management, so with growing turnover and slack there is no shortfall prompting problemistic search.

The manhole floor door with integrated railing is a low-cost extension of established hardware serving steady municipal safety requirements, so its results likely meet aspirations and carrying it costs little.

Control technology for water engineering machinery links the firm's proprietary machinery with its automation software and is central to its integrated offer, so dropping it would weaken the core business.

The flow measurement automation software is close to the established offer and supports predictive, data-driven operation, and with no archived evidence of a shortfall, organisational slack allows the firm to keep developing it.
